name: I couldn't sleep last night.
source:
A small game about the capitalistic nightmare of marketing your dreams.

A girl just moved to a big city to find more opportunities to succeed as a musician. She brought all her savings, but it's never enough. Help her to make the right choices.

A magical realism slice-of-life adventure.

[From [url=https://gromans.itch.io/i-couldnt-sleep-last-night]Itch.io[/url]]
